basic_details.short_information: Register for Job Alerts The official notification does not specify the application fee.

qualification.details: Qualification: For Retd. Employees: Ministerial Officers who retired as Typist-cum-Assistant available at district head quarters, or retired from service on attaining superannuation and not attained 65 years of age, with computer operation knowledge/qualification.; For Outsiders: Graduate from any recognized University and passed A.P. Government Technical Examination in English Typewriting by Higher Grade, with computer operation knowledge/qualification. Age limit: Completed the age of 18 years and must not have completed the age of 42 years (as on 31 October 2026) Age relaxation: SC 5, ST 5, BC 5 | Other conditions: | Must have knowledge or qualification in computer operation. Candidate must be of sound health, active habits and free from bodily defects or infirmity.

exam_pattern.details: No T.A. and D.A. will be paid to the candidates to attend the interview.

how_to_apply: Download or obtain the prescribed proforma (Bio-data) application form from the notification.
Fill in all details completely and affix a latest passport size photograph attested by a Gazetted Officer, plus one detachable photo.

Enclose attested copies of required certificates (age, caste, educational, technical and service certificates) and a self-addressed postal envelope with postage of Rs.40/- for registered post with acknowledgment due.
Address the application to the Chairman-cum-Prl. District Judge, District Legal Services Authority, Nyaya Seva Sadan, District Court compound, Kurnool, KURNOOL DISTRICT.
Send the application by Registered Post, by hand under proper acknowledgment, or by courier so as to reach by 20.11.2026 up to 5.00 PM.
important_instructions: Applications received after the last date will not be accepted. Appointing authority reserves the right to cancel the notification without assigning any reason.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for District Legal Services Authority, Kurnool Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in District Legal Services Authority, Kurnool Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Typist-cum-Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for District Legal Services Authority, Kurnool Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed proforma attached to the notification) and send it to The Chairman-cum-Prl. District Judge, District Legal Services Authority, Nyaya Seva Sadan, District Court compound, Kurnool, KURNOOL DISTRICT, by registered post, by hand under proper acknowledgment, or courier, to reach by 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is completed the age of 18 years and must not have completed the age of 42 years (as on 31 October 2026). Relaxation: SC 5, ST 5, BC 5.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 25,220 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Graduate with A.P. Government Technical Examination in English Typewriting by Higher Grade or Retired Ministerial Officers / Typist-cum-Assistant, with computer operation knowledge.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must have knowledge or qualification in computer operation. Candidate must be of sound health, active habits and free from bodily defects or infirmity.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Incomplete applications or applications without required attested copies of documents. Applications received in any other format than enclosed.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Typing test as the case may be. Interview. Selection will be made on a temporary basis by conducting a typing test and interview.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Contract basis for a period of one year from the date of selection. Extension on yearly basis on satisfactory performance.
